nodes.name: Generate Recipes API
nodes.notes: Public Angular endpoint. Responses are returned exclusively through explicit Respond to Webhook nodes.

nodes.name: Normalize & Validate Request
nodes.notes: Validates schema version 2, ingredients, preferences, serving and cook limits, and the IPv4/IPv6 client address.

nodes.name: Request Valid?
nodes.notes: Stops invalid frontend payloads before quota checks and AI generation.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  request_id:
    $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.request?.clientRequestId || null,

  client_ip:
    $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.clientIp,

  status: 'rejected',
  stage: 'request_validation',
  error_code: 'invalid_request',

  error_message:
    $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.errorMessage,

  metadata: {},

  created_at:
    $now.toISO()
} }}

nodes.name: Log Invalid Request
nodes.notes: Stores a rejected request audit event in Firebase Realtime Database.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: false, error: { code: 'invalid_request', message: $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.errorMessage } } }}

nodes.name: Respond Invalid Request
nodes.notes: Returns a structured validation error to the Angular frontend.

nodes.name: Quota Allowed?
nodes.notes: Allows Gemini generation only when both the per-IP and global Firebase daily limits have room for three recipes.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  request_id:
    $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.request.clientRequestId,

  client_ip:
    $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.clientIp,

  status:
    'quota_rejected',

  stage:
    'quota',

  error_code:
    $('Evaluate Daily Quota').item.json.reason,

  error_message:
    'Daily recipe quota rejected the request.',

  metadata:
    $('Evaluate Daily Quota').item.json,

  created_at:
    $now.toISO()
} }}

nodes.name: Log Quota Rejection
nodes.notes: Logs daily-limit and throttling rejections.

nodes.name: Respond Quota Reached
nodes.notes: Returns a clear quota-limit error to the Angular frontend.

parameters.subject: Code-a-Cuisine: Quota backend error
parameters.text:
=Firebase konnte für die Quota-Prüfung nicht erreicht werden.

Bitte n8n-Ausführung kontrollieren.

nodes.name: Email Quota Backend Error
nodes.notes: Sends an SMTP alert when the quota backend fails.

nodes.name: Respond Quota Backend Error
nodes.notes: Returns a controlled backend error without exposing internal Firebase details.

nodes.name: Generate 3 Recipes with Gemini
nodes.notes: Generates only an untrusted recipe draft. IDs, ingredient metadata, totals, validation, and persistence are handled server-side.

nodes.name: Parse AI JSON
nodes.notes: Accepts only a JSON object and converts parsing failures into a controlled validation result.

nodes.name: Validate & Build Recipe Response
nodes.notes: Performs server-side validation for exactly three recipes, ingredient coverage, additional ingredients, cooking time, nutrition, cook assignments, and parallel work, then builds trusted Firebase records.

nodes.name: AI Output Valid?
nodes.notes: Prevents invalid or incomplete AI output from being persisted.

nodes.name: Persist 3 Recipes in Firebase
nodes.notes: Atomically persists the three validated recipes to Firebase Realtime Database using the server-side Google Service Account.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  request_id:
    $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.request.clientRequestId,

  client_ip:
    $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.clientIp,

  status:
    'success',

  stage:
    'complete',

  error_code:
    null,

  error_message:
    null,

  metadata: {
    recipeIds:
      $('Validate & Build Recipe Response')
        .item.json.response.recipes
        .map(r => r.id),

    quota:
      $('Evaluate Daily Quota').item.json
  },

  created_at:
    $now.toISO()
} }}

nodes.name: Log Successful Generation
nodes.notes: Stores a successful generation audit event in Firebase Realtime Database.

nodes.name: Respond 3 Recipes
nodes.notes: Returns the exact Angular schema-version-2 response after successful persistence.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  request_id:
    $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.request.clientRequestId,

  client_ip:
    $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.clientIp,

  status:
    'failed',

  stage:
    'ai_provider',

  error_code:
    'ai_provider_error',

  error_message:
    'Gemini request failed.',

  metadata: {},

  created_at:
    $now.toISO()
} }}

nodes.name: Log AI Provider Error
nodes.notes: Stores a Gemini provider failure event in Firebase Realtime Database.

parameters.subject: Code-a-Cuisine: AI provider error
parameters.text:
=Gemini konnte Request {{ $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.request.clientRequestId }} nicht verarbeiten.

Bitte n8n-Ausführung kontrollieren.

nodes.name: Email AI Provider Error
nodes.notes: Notifies the operator when the AI provider fails.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: false, error: { code: 'ai_provider_error', message: 'Die KI ist aktuell nicht erreichbar. Bitte später erneut versuchen.' } } }}

nodes.name: Respond AI Provider Error
nodes.notes: Returns a controlled AI provider error to the Angular frontend.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  request_id:
    $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.request.clientRequestId,

  client_ip:
    $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.clientIp,

  status:
    'failed',

  stage:
    'ai_validation',

  error_code:
    $('Validate & Build Recipe Response').item.json.errorCode,

  error_message:
    $('Validate & Build Recipe Response').item.json.errorMessage,

  metadata: {},

  created_at:
    $now.toISO()
} }}

nodes.name: Log Invalid AI Response
nodes.notes: Stores an invalid AI response event in Firebase Realtime Database.

parameters.subject: Code-a-Cuisine: invalid AI response
parameters.text:
=Gemini lieferte für Request {{ $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.request.clientRequestId }} eine fachlich ungültige Antwort.

Grund: {{ $('Validate & Build Recipe Response').item.json.errorMessage }}

nodes.name: Email Invalid AI Response
nodes.notes: Alerts the operator when the model output violates the required structure or business rules.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: false, error: { code: 'invalid_ai_response', message: 'Die KI konnte kein gültiges Rezeptset erzeugen. Bitte erneut versuchen.' } } }}

nodes.name: Respond Invalid AI Response
nodes.notes: Prevents unvalidated model output from reaching the Angular frontend.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  request_id:
    $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.request.clientRequestId,

  client_ip:
    $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.clientIp,

  status:
    'failed',

  stage:
    'persistence',

  error_code:
    'firebase_write_failed',

  error_message:
    'Firebase recipe write failed.',

  metadata: {},

  created_at:
    $now.toISO()
} }}

nodes.name: Log Firebase Persistence Error
nodes.notes: Stores a recipe persistence failure event in Firebase Realtime Database.

parameters.subject: Code-a-Cuisine: Firebase persistence error
parameters.text:
=Die drei validierten Rezepte für Request {{ $('Normalize & Validate Request').item.json.request.clientRequestId }} konnten nicht in Firebase gespeichert werden.

Bitte Firebase/n8n-Ausführung kontrollieren.

nodes.name: Email Firebase Persistence Error
nodes.notes: Alerts the operator when persistent recipe storage fails.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: false, error: { code: 'firebase_write_failed', message: 'Die Rezepte konnten nicht gespeichert werden. Bitte erneut versuchen.' } } }}

nodes.name: Respond Persistence Error
nodes.notes: Returns a controlled error because Angular receives recipes only after successful persistence.

nodes.name: Evaluate Daily Quota
nodes.notes: Calculates whether another three-recipe generation fits inside the Firebase daily limits.

nodes.name: Read Daily Quota from Firebase
nodes.notes: Calculates whether another three-recipe generation fits inside the Firebase daily limits.

nodes.name: Record Quota Usage in Firebase
nodes.notes: Records the three successfully persisted recipes against the Firebase daily quota.
